subject: A homepage idea for Calgary Core Physiotherapy
text:
Hello Calgary Core team,

638 five-star Google reviews, many from patients who had bad luck at other clinics before finding Dylan and Tim: that says a lot. We designed a homepage concept for Calgary Core Physiotherapy: https://sitesbyms.com/calgary-core-physiotherapy/

On the page, one tap gets you a competitive analysis: how you compare with 4–5 physio clinics nearby and where you may be losing patients. No forms, nothing to fill in.

Best regards,
